race.comment: NINE (3) drew wide and worked in a Breeders Challenge heat last start so will enjoy the class drop. Good effort when runner-up at this circuit and distance prior. Well drawn and nicely placed in a maiden. WICKED DAVIE (5) lines up for the first time. By McWicked and hails from the  Harpley stable. Has been trialling well so expect a strong showing. Rock N Roll Heaven filly ELECTRA SHARK (8) draws wide but has been trialling well so is worth keeping safe. PLUTOPHOBIA (1) hails from a good yard and the ace draw is an aid to a first starter.
